blocks.content:
• Constituent Assembly formed: 1946
• First meeting: 9 December 1946
• Drafting Committee Chairman: Dr. B. R. Ambedkar
• Constitution adopted: 26 November 1949
• Constitution enforced: 26 January 1950
• Time taken: 2 years, 11 months, 18 days
• Approximate cost: ₹64 lakh

26 November is celebrated as **Constitution Day**.
26 January is celebrated as **Republic Day**.
26 November is celebrated as Constitution Day.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Constituent Assembly was formed in 1946 and held its first meeting on 9 December 1946.
Dr. B. R. Ambedkar headed the Drafting Committee as its Chairman.
The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949 and officially enforced on 26 January 1950.
The entire process took nearly 3 years (2 years, 11 months, 18 days) with an estimated expenditure of ₹64 lakh.
